newsitem.title: UK: British Steel down as Merrill cuts forecasts.
newsitem.headline: British Steel down as Merrill cuts forecasts.

text.p: Shares in British Steel Plc dropped on Wednesday as analysts at Merrill Lynch cut earnings estimates for the company, market sources said.
The stock was down 2p at 154-1/2 by 1459 GMT.
For the year ended March 1998 Merrill cut its forecast for pre-tax profit to 280 million stg, market sources said, with its earnings per share forecast lowered to 8.6p per share.
Its previous forecasts were for pre-tax profit of 650 million stg and eps of 21.6p, according to the Estimate Directory.
For the current year Merrill expects pre-tax profits of 500 million stg and earnings per share of 16.4p, sources said. Merrill repeated a "neutral" rating on the stock.
Further details were not immediately available and analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
By 1509 GMT the stock was down 3-3/4p at 152-3/4 in active volume of 8.5 million shares.
For the year ended March 1996 British Steel posted pre-tax profits of 1.1 billion stg.
